capability.title: Coordinate Agent Video Studio
capability.description: Host-owned AVS workflow coordination across the exact public MCP leaves for editable CodexVideo handoff, auto-edit planning and application, timeline operations, validation, local render, and optional UI inspection.

runtimeBinding.instruction: Coordinate the requested AVS workflow in the host agent (Codex or Claude Code). Follow the package's public Agent Video Studio coordinator contract, call only exact available agent_video_studio MCP tools, preserve returned project/session/revision/media/track/clip IDs, and report actual downstream results. Do not claim that the broker or AVS server called another server, do not perform STT/TTS/provider generation/publishing/authentication, and stop when required authority, confirmation, target binding, or exact descriptor pins are unavailable.

inputSchema.title: Agent Video Studio coordinator input
inputSchema.description: Complete host-owned goal and routing context for coordinating the public AVS MCP surface.

outputSchema.title: Agent Video Studio coordinator output
outputSchema.description: Complete host-authored coordination record; it reports exact AVS MCP actions and results without claiming the broker or AVS server invoked another server.
